name: phase_01_admin_session_revocation
lock_risk: Adds two nullable session assurance-binding columns with a metadata-only constraint, then creates one initially empty replay table and one bounded target index.
representative_data: Runs against empty, version-two, version-seven, and deterministic three-principal Phase 01 migration lanes; integration evidence exercises concurrent identical and mismatched administrator revocation requests.
query_plan_review: The unique actor/idempotency index serializes replay lookup while the session primary key locks actor and target authority rows; the target index supports bounded security review.
space_risk: Adds nullable step-up evidence to each application session and one hash-only replay fact per administrator revocation attempt.
forward_fix: Correct constraints, grants, or replay semantics with a new ordered migration while preserving session assurance evidence, authorization decisions, and audit facts.
rollback: Disable the administrator route before a forward fix; do not erase revocation replay records, restore revoked sessions, or weaken action-bound step-up and audit atomicity.
